_instructions: Source of truth for the build. DO NOT delete, edit, or renumber existing ids/titles. Statuses: passing (done+proven), failing (actionable), deferred (postponed; notes say when actionable), superseded (dead, kept for history). Flip failing->passing only when a test or the stated manual check proves it. Append new features with the next id in their milestone. Work ONE feature per session: lowest milestone, then lowest id, among 'failing'.

features.title: A bug session reproduces before it fixes: the builder's first commit-worthy step is a test that fails on the reported symptom, no fix or hypothesis before it; after the fix the PROGRESS entry carries a one-line Lesson; the evaluator checks the repro test exists and failed first
features.notes: Base the rule on Stefano's lean-debugging skill (sedybenoitpeace-skills, lean-skills plugin): reproduce in isolation, one hypothesis at a time, failing regression test before the single root-cause fix, verify. Add from Pocock's diagnosing-bugs: the repro must fail on the reported symptom, not a nearby failure; a flaky bug is looped until it reproduces often enough to debug. Unattended: after 3 failed fixes the session stops blocked with Needs a human instead of asking.
